GLOBAL_FILE_LIMIT = 64
ALIAS_FILE_LIMIT = GLOBAL_FILE_LIMIT


class IncludeLimits:
    max_include_files: int = 16
    max_file_count: int = ALIAS_FILE_LIMIT
    max_document_bytes: int = 1_048_576
    max_transfer_bytes: int = 1_048_576
    max_archive_bytes: int = 8_388_608
    max_computed_bytes: int = 8 * 1024 * 1024
    max_dynamic_bytes: int = build_default()
    retry_limit: int = 1
